Contract Special Terms: Evergreen: Yes ; Notice Period: 365 Days 12. Credit Support. (a) Provision of Credit Support. Commencing January 1, 2008, and at any time during the term of this Precedent Agreement or the Service Agreement that SHIPPER fails to meet TRANSPORTER's creditworthiness requirements set forth herein, SHIPPER agrees to provide one or more of the following forms of credit support for the entirety of SHIPPER's obligations under this Precedent Agreement and, if executed, the Service Agreement (collectively, "SHIPPER's Obligations"), which credit support may be provided on behalf of SHIPPER from each of SHIPPER's Members or a Member's Affiliated Guarantor (if applicable): (i) A guaranty, executed by a creditworthy Person, in such form as SHIPPER and TRANSPORTER agree. The Parties agree to negotiate in good faith and endeavor to reach agreement on an acceptable form or forms of guaranty before September 30, 2007, and if agreed, such form or forms shall be attached as Exhibit C; (ii) A standby irrevocable letter of credit, drawn upon a bank acceptable to TRANSPORTER, substantially in the form attached as Exhibit C hereto or in such other form as SHIPPER and TRANSPORTER agree. For purposes of this Paragraph 12(a)(ii), a bank with a long term debt rating of A- or better from Standard and Poor's or long term debt rating of A3 or better from Moody's will be deemed acceptable to TRANSPORTER provided that such bank maintains a physical location within the United States. (iii) Such other form of credit support that is acceptable to TRANSPORTER. (b) TRANSPORTER agrees that any necessary credit support provided by SHIPPER may be provided on behalf of SHIPPER by SHIPPER's creditworthy Members or a Member's Affiliated Guarantor (if applicable) pro rata based on each Member's ownership interest of SHIPPER, as such ownership interest may change from time to time or on such other basis acceptable to SHIPPER, which in the aggregate represents one hundred percent (100%) of the necessary credit support. SHIPPER shall give TRANSPORTER notice of any change in the pro rata share of credit support to be provided by SHIPPER's Members as soon as practicable after the change occurs. SHIPPER shall provide TRANSPORTER with replacement credit support (reflecting the change in the Members' ownership interests or other change) pursuant to Paragraph 12(a) above as soon as reasonably practicable after such notice but in no event later than thirty (30) days after such notice. Until such credit support is provided to TRANSPORTER, the credit support provided by or on behalf of SHIPPER prior to SHIPPER's notice of the change shall remain in effect. For the avoidance of doubt, an amendment to this Precedent Agreement will not be required in connection with such a change in the credit support to be provided by SHIPPER's Members. (c) The need for credit support pursuant to this Paragraph 12 shall be determined by TRANSPORTER based upon SHIPPER's financial condition in an amount reasonably determined by TRANSPORTER to provide TRANSPORTER reasonable assurance that SHIPPER's Obligations will be met. TRANSPORTER's creditworthiness determination shall be based on the results of a thorough analysis of SHIPPER's financial statements (including SHIPPER's income statement, balance sheet and cash flow statement). Such analysis shall include entering SHIPPER's financial statements into a database and transferring same into a proprietary financial risk rating model, which rates shippers based on a number of financial ratios, liquidity factors and other cash flow considerations. The results of such analysis include both a creditworthiness determination and a credit limit for shippers deemed creditworthy. Approved credit limits are then measured against applicable exposures. Subject to Paragraph 12(d) below, for purposes of this Precedent Agreement, a Person shall be deemed to be creditworthy if it has a long term debt rating of BBB- or better from Standard and Poor's or a rating of Baa3 or better from Moody's. If SHIPPER desires to have a Person provide credit support hereunder that is not rated by Standard and Poor's or Moody's, TRANSPORTER shall, upon SHIPPER's request, promptly (but in no event later than thirty (30) days) provide a reasonable determination of creditworthiness of such unrated Person. (d) If during the term of this Precedent Agreement and, if executed, the Service Agreement there are material, adverse changes to the financial status of any Person providing credit support for SHIPPER's Obligations and, as a result of such changes, such Person is no longer creditworthy in TRANSPORTER's reasonable determination, TRANSPORTER shall provide written notice to SHIPPER thereof and SHIPPER shall promptly (but in no event later than thirty (30) days after receipt of such notice) provide credit support pursuant to Paragraph 12(a) above to replace the credit support provided by such Person. (e) Subject to Paragraph 12(g) below, TRANSPORTER may not require SHIPPER to provide credit support in an amount exceeding the lesser of: (i) SHIPPER's Proportionate Share of the Applicable Total Costs (as hereinafter defined) and (ii) the net present value (calculated using the interest rate determined in accordance with 18 C.F.R. Section 154.501(d)(1) of the FERC's regulations) of the reservation charges due TRANSPORTER for the Primary Term of the Service Agreement or, if the Primary Term of the Service Agreement has commenced, the remaining portion of the Primary Term of the Service Agreement. For the period prior to the in-service date of TRANSPORTER'S Expansion Facilities (the "Pre-Operation Phase"), the term "Applicable Total Costs" as used herein shall mean the costs TRANSPORTER has then incurred to construct, or has binding commitments for the construction and/or completion of, TRANSPORTER's Expansion Facilities, but in no event shall the Applicable Total Costs for the Pre-Operation Phase exceed $36,800,000. During the Pre-Operation Phase, SHIPPER's credit support requirement shall increase in accordance with TRANSPORTER's expected construction expenditures and commitments as set forth in the schedule in Exhibit D hereto. If there is a material change in the timing of TRANSPORTER's construction expenditures and commitments, the schedule in Exhibit D shall be revised to reflect such change. On and after the date that TRANSPORTER's Expansion Facilities have been placed into service ("In-Service Phase"), the term "Applicable Total Costs" shall mean the Applicable Total Costs of TRANSPORTER's Expansion Facilities as of the end of the Pre-Operation Phase (not to exceed $36,800,000) reduced during the In-Service Phase at a rate of five percent (5%) per annum, as illustrated in the schedule set forth in Exhibit D. As used in this Paragraph, SHIPPER's "Proportionate Share" of the Applicable Total Costs shall be determined by multiplying the Applicable Total Costs by a ratio, the numerator of which is SHIPPER's TCQ and the denominator of which is the total firm transportation capacity of TRANSPORTER's Expansion Facilities as set forth in the FERC Application. (f) SHIPPER shall not be required by TRANSPORTER to provide credit support prior to January 1, 2008. (g) Notwithstanding anything herein to the contrary, in no event shall the level of credit support for SHIPPER's Obligations during the primary term of the Service Agreement or during any extension thereof pursuant to Paragraph 6 above be less than the minimum credit support required by TRANSPORTER's FERC Gas Tariff. (h) If credit support is being provided hereunder by the Members or Member's Affiliated Guarantors and SHIPPER fails to pay TRANSPORTER the full amount of SHIPPER's Obligations when due, except for amounts being disputed in accordance with the terms of TRANSPORTER's FERC Gas Tariff, then SHIPPER may provide TRANSPORTER with a statement, included with the partial payment, identifying which Member or Member's Affiliated Guarantor TRANSPORTER should pursue for satisfaction of the deficiency, provided that such deficiency does not exceed the credit support provided by such Member or Member's Affiliated Guarantor. If SHIPPER has identified such a Member or Member's Affiliated Guarantor to be pursued for satisfaction of the deficiency in accordance with the foregoing sentence, TRANSPORTER shall pursue the credit support provided by that Member or Member's Affiliated Guarantor and shall not pursue the credit support provided by or on behalf of another Member or Member's Affiliated Guarantor. If SHIPPER has not identified the Member or Member's Affiliated Guarantor to be pursued for satisfaction of the deficiency, then SHIPPER, on its own behalf and on behalf of each Member and Member's Affiliated Guarantor, hereby (i) grants consent to TRANSPORTER to pursue the proportionate share of SHIPPER's credit support provided by each Member or Member's Affiliated Guarantor, and (ii) releases and forever discharges TRANSPORTER and its Affiliates from any liability of any kind and nature whatsoever, at law, in equity, pursuant to statute or otherwise, whether in tort, contract or otherwise, whether known or unknown, arising out of TRANSPORTER pursuing such credit support pursuant to the foregoing clause (i). Notwithstanding anything herein to the contrary, each Party hereby expressly reserves all rights and remedies under TRANSPORTER's FERC Gas Tariff and otherwise available at law in the event of (A) non-payment of 100 percent (100%) of SHIPPER's obligations under the Service Agreement, and/or (B) failure by SHIPPER to provide credit support for 100 percent (100%) of SHIPPER's Obligations pursuant to this Paragraph 12. Pressure(s) Buyer shall deliver or cause to be delivered gas at the Point of Receipt at a pressure no less than 1380 psig, or such lower pressure as may be agreed upon by Seller and Buyer in writing. Specification of Negotiated Rate and Term ----------------------------------------- Term: 20 years from and after the effective date of this Service Agreement ("Primary Term") Transportation Contract Quantity: 467,390 dt/day Negotiated Reservation Rate: $ 0.078 Dt/day In addition to the Negotiated Reservation Rate, Buyer shall be responsible for compressor fuel and line-loss makeup retention and shall pay the electric power charges (which charges may include a commodity component) for Seller's Rate Zone 4A, and all applicable surcharges set forth in Seller's FERC Gas Tariff for Rate Schedule FT service to Buyer under this Service Agreement as approved by FERC. The fuel and line-loss makeup retention, electric power charges, and applicable surcharges are subject to change from time to time as approved by the FERC. Seller agrees not to file or cause to be filed with the FERC under Section 4 of the NGA to seek to modify the negotiated rate set forth above. Buyer agrees not to file or cause to be filed with the FERC any action, claim, complaint, or other pleading under Section 5 of the NGA, or support or participate in any such proceeding initiated by any other party, requesting a change to or in any way opposing the negotiated rate set forth above. Seller will agree, upon written request by Buyer at least one (1) year prior to the end of the Primary Term, to extend the term of this Service Agreement for an additional one to five-year period ("First Additional Term") at the TCQ and Negotiated Reservation Rate that applied during the Primary Term or to such smaller TCQ as Buyer designates in its notice to Seller. Seller will further agree, upon written request by Buyer at least one (1) year prior to the end of the First Additional Term, to extend the term of the Service Agreement for a second additional term of one to five years at the TCQ and Negotiated Reservation Rate that applied during the First Additional Term or to such smaller TCQ as Buyer designates in its notice to Seller.
